## v1.2.0 — 2026-10-01

**Instagram voice and video calls now work, in a window of their own.**

### ✨ Highlights

- **Calls in their own window** — Voice and video calls open in a separate window, so the main window stays usable during a call. Hanging up closes only the call window.
- **Microphone and camera that work** — Turn on **Allow microphone** / **Allow camera** in Settings > Calls; InstaDesktop asks once and remembers your answer instead of silently blocking the call.
- **Redesigned Settings** — Settings are grouped into cards with short descriptions, a dark title bar, a clear **Save** button and the current microphone and camera status.

### 🛠️ Improvements

- Turning a switch off stops the microphone or camera immediately, including in a call that is already running.
- When a call is blocked because a switch is off, a tray notice explains why; clicking it opens Settings.
- Your Yes or No is kept across restarts. To be asked again, turn the switch off and on, or use **Reset website permissions**.
- Only `instagram.com` and `www.instagram.com` can ask for the microphone or camera. The hidden background inbox can never use them.
- New shortcuts to the Windows microphone and camera privacy settings.
- **Reset website permissions** now tells you when Instagram has not loaded yet instead of reporting success.
- The main window keeps normal memory priority while a call window is open.
- Clearer local diagnostics: permission decisions and the call window lifecycle are recorded in the app log with fixed codes. No names, addresses or call content are logged.

### 🐛 Fixes

- Fixed: Microphone and camera were inaccessible during calls (known issue since v1.0.0). A denial saved while a switch was off could never be undone; the first start of v1.2.0 clears such a saved denial once, so Instagram asks again. Nothing is granted automatically.
- Fixed: Starting a call replaced the whole app with the call screen.
- Fixed: Turning off **Allow microphone** or **Allow camera** did not revoke access Instagram already had.
- Fixed: A leftover "Sidebar mode" label appeared in Settings without an option.

### 🔄 Updating

Existing users can simply launch InstaDesktop. If an update is available, the app downloads the latest installer from this Release and upgrades automatically.

> **Upgrading from v1.0.0:** the v1.0.0 updater cannot read GitHub Releases, so install this version once manually. Every later version installs automatically.

Manual installation is also available:

1. Download **`InstaDesktop-Setup.exe`** below.
2. Run it; your profile and custom `Assets` are preserved.

### 📦 Downloads

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `InstaDesktop-Setup.exe` | Recommended per-user Windows installer |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for downloaded files |

### ✅ Verification

- Windows 10/11 x64
- Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime
- Automated: 103 microphone, camera and call window checks using virtual devices, and 270 notification, update and WebView2 integration checks
- Checked against a live Instagram call: the call opens as a pop-up and the microphone request is asked and remembered

### ⚠️ Known Issues

- When Instagram only shows "N new messages" for a conversation, the notification shows that summary instead of the text.
- Turning off **Allow camera** during a call also interrupts that call's audio; Instagram can request the microphone again without a new prompt.
- Windows must also allow desktop apps to use the microphone and camera (Settings > Privacy & security).

### 🔐 Security & privacy

No credentials or profile data are included in release assets. Update downloads use HTTPS from this repository's Releases, and the installer's SHA-256 is verified before execution.
